script.text: You lose, Kaiba boy. And you’ve lost much more than just this duel.
You’ve lost the only chance you had at rescuing your baby brother. You let him down. But don’t worry, my dear friend. I will spare you the agony of carrying on in this world without him!
Pegasus held up a blank card.
It is the final fate of your soul, Seto Kaiba!
Maximillion Pegasus captured Kaiba's soul with his Millennium Eye, trapping it in the blank card. Pegasus now had Seto Kaiba, Mokuba, and Yugi's grandpa's souls.
Welcome to your new home. A place of solitude and seclusion.
Ah, the brothers Kaiba. One in each of my hands. But even though your cards are so very close, your souls have never been further apart.
